visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a white jacket and a pink motorcycle helmet enters a bright, modern restaurant carrying several plastic bags filled with lunch boxes. The setting is clean with light wood accents and green plants near the counter. (2) A wooden tray is presented featuring a black bento box filled with pork ribs, rice, and vegetables, accompanied by a cup of tea and a bowl of soup. (3) Extreme close-ups show glistening, steamed pork ribs topped with red chili and green scallions. The lighting is bright and warm, emphasizing the texture of the meat. (4) The camera shows a view of several customers sitting at light wood tables in the dining area. (5) A hand is seen pouring a brownish beverage into a small plastic cup from a beverage dispenser labeled with drink graphics. (6) A clear plastic spoon scoops egg drop soup from a white paper bowl, revealing the yellow egg ribbons. (7) Various bento boxes are assembled, including one with a large fried chicken leg and another with minced pork. Hands use metal tongs to place ingredients into the black containers. (8) Chopsticks tear into a crispy fried chicken leg to reveal the white, juicy meat inside. The skin has a golden-brown, flaky texture. (9) A spoon lifts a portion of minced pork over white rice, showing bits of basil and chili. (10) A grilled salmon fillet is shown resting on a bed of rice, served with a lime wedge. Chopsticks break off a piece of the pink flesh. (11) A staff member in a black t-shirt with a brand logo is shown scooping minced pork into a bento box in a professional kitchen setting with stainless steel trays. (12) The final scene shows the exterior of the restaurant with a colorful balloon arch and a white sign with black text, under natural daylight.
